resume.title: # Resume {{kit}}
resume.intro: This work was set aside on the owner's word. The kit holds everything needed to continue; no earlier conversation is required.
steps: 3. Continue from the next action below.
retirement: Treat the previous holder's agents and processes as unverified: re-read the park note, check the checkout against it, and act only on what you can observe.

The holder that wrote this note is retired, not resumed. Start work only after its stop is observed and its children are accounted for; otherwise report a blocker. Where no stop can be observed, say so instead of assuming one.
Forcibly ending the previous holder is out of scope here (N15).
